With its sleek exterior, spacious interior, and impressive array of advanced features, this Silverado is the perfect companion for both work and play.

- MANAGER SPECIAL
- PRICED TO SELL
- VERY CLEAN
- 5.3L V8 (EcoTec3) with Dynamic Fuel Management
- Convenience Package
- Preferred Equipment Group 1LT
- Trailering Package
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Leather Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Keyless Open & Start
- Power Door Locks
- Heated Driver & Front Outboard Passenger Seats
- Rear 60/40 Folding Bench Seat (Folds Up)
- Hitch Guidance

Under the hood, the Silverados EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine delivers a commanding 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, providing the muscle you need for towing, hauling, and tackling any task with ease. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, this powertrain offers a seamless blend of power and efficiency, with an impressive fuel economy rating of 17 mpg in the city and 23 mpg on the highway.

The Silverados interior is a study in refinement, with a spacious and well-appointed cabin that offers a wealth of comfort and convenience features. Dual-zone automatic climate control, a heated steering wheel, and heated front seats ensure you and your passengers stay comfortable in any weather. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system, complete with a 4.2-inch diagonal color display, provides intuitive control over your entertainment, communication, and navigation needs.

For those who value capability and versatility, the Silverados Trailering Package and EZ Lift Power Lock & Release Tailgate make towing and loading a breeze. The Rear Vision Camera and Hitch Guidance features further enhance the Silverados utility, allowing you to navigate tight spaces and hitching up with confidence.

Whether youre tackling a job site, heading out on a weekend adventure, or simply commuting in style, this 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT is the perfect choice. With its impressive performance, refined interior, and comprehensive suite of features, this truck is sure to exceed your expectations. Visit our showroom today and experience the power and capability of the Silverado for yourself.
